lines.text: Hiram of Tyre sent cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters to build David a palace; David knew the LORD established him.
The Philistines heard David was anointed king over all Israel, searched for him, and raided the Valley of Elah.
David inquired of God, defeated the Philistines at Baal-perazim, and ordered their abandoned gods burned in the fire.
When the Philistines raided again, God told David to circle around and attack them in front of the olive trees.
David did as God commanded, and they struck down the Philistine army from Gibeon to Gezer.
